command: set -eu; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; whoami; date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; echo '===GIT_CHECKOUTS==='; find /home/ai-core-node -maxdepth 4 -type d -name .git -print 2>/dev/null | sed 's#/.git$##' | head -80 | while read d; do u=$(git -C "$d" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true); case "$u" in *gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git|*gschaidergabriel/frankenstein) echo "REPO=$d"; echo "REMOTE=$u"; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD; git -C "$d" branch --show-current; git -C "$d" status --short | head -40;; esac; done; echo '===VOICE_EFFECTIVE==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ExecStart --value 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===VOICE_FILES==='; for p in /home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein/scripts /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo/scripts; do if [ -d "$p" ]; then echo "DIR=$p"; for f in voice_final_runtime.py voice_full_runtime.py omega_voice_world_patch.py omega_world_turn.py omega_runtime.py; do [ -f "$p/$f" ] && sha256sum "$p/$f"; done; fi; done
